name: simulate_mandelbrot
description: Runs a JAX-accelerated Mandelbrot simulation on the specified center coordinates and zoom factor. Returns visual complexity and Shannon entropy metrics.

center_real.description: Real coordinate of the center of the viewport.

center_imag.description: Imaginary coordinate of the center of the viewport.

zoom.description: Zoom factor (e.g. 1.5 for global view, >= 15000 for close-up details).

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations for the escape calculation. Defaults to 500.
